contract: A23-61 + 검수 2026-10-07: a swing with no monster / player / goose inside the front half (AimCone) aims at the nearest monster within Range in any direction (the client FaceTarget rule) and turns the root to it (CFrame.lookAt); the swing is then judged from that facing (Around: its front half, Splash / Multi: that target first) on monsters only - players and the goose keep the real front-half rule. Something inside the front half always wins (no turn). Auto combat swings whenever a monster is within Range (same rule).
limitations: The real network delay and the client's own turn are not simulated; the root turn is a CFrame.lookAt double. Skills Q / Z get the same rule in SKL-2 (SkillService).
